reason: I'd probably use the free first visit, but $15 a kid to sit in a nice room is a lot when the library, parks and church group cost nothing. I only pay for an indoor place on a week of rain, and that's rare.
objection: Isn't this just CoCo's Funhouse with nicer decor? Fifteen dollars a visit adds up fast with more than one kid, and I already have free things that fill the week.
would_change_my_mind: A drop-in around $8 to $10 per child, or proof that it's really cleaner and calmer than the other indoor places I've tried.
